maria: Quick ask for runtime — can we get a fast rerun of the webinar cohort for next Tue's demo? Need p50/p95/p99, a small coldstart heatmap, and 200 sample token traces for the blog.

samir: Which model/hardware and exact cohort?

maria: Use "webinar-cohort-final" (mix chat + long prompts). Primary: q4_0 on gpunode-rt-4. Fallback: cpu-q-small.

ryan: Also include a 200-sample AB comparing q4_0 vs q5_0 for quality vs perf. Short summary only.

samir: Will run: coldstart sweep, steady-state, and AB probe. Will tag artifacts for blog/demo and include manifest + seed + replay CLI. ETA ~45m.

laura: Marketing needs the 200 traces + methodology blurb by 48h before demo. Can you scope outputs?

samir: We'll prioritize the curated 200 traces and aggregated metrics; full dump later if needed. Methodology will be a short bullet list with warmup, batch, kv-cache, and seed.

nisha: Please confirm traces are scrubbed of PII and that manifest includes exact command to reproduce a p99 case.

samir: Traces sanitized. Example replay command we'll add to manifest: `rt-bench replay --run webinar-1839991234-01 --case p99-idx-17 --target gpunode-rt-4`.

engbot: run started: id=webinar-1839991234-01. artifacts -> s3://redwood-bench/webinar/webinar-1839991234/.

engbot: run complete. artifacts: manifest.json, p50_p95_p99.csv, heatmap.png, 200-sample-traces.tar.gz, ab_summary.json. checksum sha256:deadbeef...

maria: Perfect. One-liner from runtime for blog: "Results apply to the specified cohort and hardware; performance varies with prompt mix and seq length. See methodology manifest to reproduce."

ryan: Confirmed no sensitive payloads. Thanks all.

maria: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: routing note: funnel webinar leads to demo@redwood.com (AE queue 2).
